hook.say: The ten longest rivers on Earth, ranked. Scientists still argue about number one!

items.name: Amur
items.say: Number ten: Ah-moor, dividing Russia and China. 4444 kilometers.
items.cap: Number ten: Amur, dividing Russia and China. 4,444 kilometers.

items.name: Congo
items.say: Nine: Congo, the deepest river on Earth. 4700 kilometers.
items.cap: Nine: Congo, the deepest river on Earth. 4,700 kilometers.

items.name: Paraná
items.sub: RÍO DE LA PLATA · SOUTH AMERICA
items.say: Eight: Para-nah, South America's second longest. 4880 kilometers.
items.cap: Eight: Paraná, South America's second longest. 4,880 kilometers.

items.name: Ob-Irtysh
items.say: Seven: Obe-Irtish, flowing north to the Arctic. 5410 kilometers.
items.cap: Seven: Ob-Irtysh, flowing north to the Arctic. 5,410 kilometers.

items.name: Yellow River
items.say: Six: Yellow River, cradle of Chinese civilization. 5464 kilometers.
items.cap: Six: Yellow River, cradle of Chinese civilization. 5,464 kilometers.

items.name: Yenisei
items.say: Five: Yenni-say, the Arctic's biggest river. 5539 kilometers.
items.cap: Five: Yenisei, the Arctic's biggest river. 5,539 kilometers.

items.name: Mississippi-Missouri
items.say: Four: Mississippi-Missouri, draining thirty-one states. 6275 kilometers.
items.cap: Four: Mississippi-Missouri, draining thirty-one states. 6,275 kilometers.

items.name: Yangtze
items.say: Three: Yang-see, longest in a single country. 6300 kilometers.
items.cap: Three: Yangtze, longest in a single country. 6,300 kilometers.

items.name: Amazon
items.fact: The most water of any river
items.say: Two: Amazon, carrying the most water on Earth. 6400 kilometers.
items.cap: Two: Amazon, carrying the most water on Earth. 6,400 kilometers.

items.name: Nile
items.say: And number one: the Nile! 6650 kilometers, though some say the Amazon wins.
items.cap: And number one: the Nile! 6,650 kilometers, though some say the Amazon wins.
